test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find a single discount (rounded up to two decimal places) to equal three consecutive discounts of 6%, 28% and 15%
solution:
**Given:**

Three successive discounts: 6%, 28%, and 15%

**Formula used:**

Successive Discount = 100 × [1 − (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂) × (1 − d₃)]

**Calculation:**

⇒ Net discount = 100 × [1 − (1 − 0.06) × (1 − 0.28) × (1 − 0.15)]

⇒ Net discount = 100 × [1 − (0.94 × 0.72 × 0.85)]

⇒ Net discount = 100 × [1 − 0.57528]

⇒ Net discount = 100 × 0.42472

⇒ **Net discount = 42.47%**

**∴ A single discount equivalent to 6%, 28%, and 15% is __42.47%__.**
